text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?! Is there really a chance I won't 
get to run with the young lady?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I'm literally crying right now~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...Well, can't be helped, I guess. I'll 
just go hang out normally!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the Mile CS, I had that conversation 
with Daitaku Helios. And then, right after 
the new year began—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Shocking news suddenly came in.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
"Breaking news! Daiichi Ruby of the 
illustrious 'Splendid Clan' has 
announced... that she will be running in 
the Takamatsunomiya Kinen!"

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"—In her Classic year, she blazed through 
the Tiara path under the banner of the 
'Illustrious Clan.'"

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"Will the major spring race, the Osaka 
Hai, also be her first goal for the Senior 
Year?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"No, we shall make the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen our primary goal."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"The Takamatsunomiya Kinen, you say...? 
That's the 1,200m race that crowns the 
spring sprint champion, right?"

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"‘We were under the impression she would 
start with the Osaka Hai, followed by the 
Victoria Mile and the Takarazuka Kinen, 
but...’"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
“At present, we have no such plans. First, 
the Takamatsunomiya Kinen... I will aim 
for the pinnacle where both my mother and 
grandmother once stood.”

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Even after that— I shall continue along 
the sprint route in the Senior Class."

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
“――Well, that certainly came as a bit of a 
surprise. Daiichi Ruby, carrying the 
bloodline of the 'Illustrious Lineage,' 
had all eyes on her, but...”

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
"Does entering the Takamatsunomiya Kinen 
mean she is shifting entirely to sprints? 
...A rather unexpected development, 
wouldn't you say?"

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text:
"Her mother was truly incredible, after 
all! Winning the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, 
taking home a URA Award... She left behind 
a genuinely glorious record."

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text:
"I found myself eagerly expecting Daiichi 
Ruby-san to follow in those footsteps as 
well, but..."

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text:
"Of course I'm looking forward to the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen! To be honest, 
though, I also really wanted to see her 
run in the Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... Let us keep a close eye on 
where she goes from here. Now, onto the 
next news story."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...TBH, Ruby's the absolute cutest! We 
agree on that, right?
choice_data_list: Looks like Ruby's coming to sprints, huh
Looks like Ruby's coming to sprints, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: !!!! For real?!?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, while it's an unexpected 
turn of events... it must be welcome news 
for Daitaku Helios. However—"
choice_data_list:
(I wonder if Ruby is satisfied with 
this...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it's prestige you're after, there's the 
Tenno Sho, or the Arima Kinen, where many 
of the year's top-performing Umamusume 
compete...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The races Daiichi Ruby would have chosen 
in the past should have mostly been at 
medium distance or longer.
choice_data_list: (I wonder how she really feels deep down)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh man, I'm getting so hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I've got a feeling this year's gonna be 
super hype☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah!! Wait, sorry, I forgot to tell you!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Say, Happy New Year~?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Sweet vibes, right?☆ Let's get mega-hyped 
for the Senior Class too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The first move is suuuper important! What 
should we dooo?!
choice_data_list: Make a lot of wishes at the shrine.
Go to the club's daytime event

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: On the contrary!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You're seriously so stylish, Trainy-P☆ 
Let's go glamping then!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Or so I thought, though!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"The winter mountains are crazy coooold!! 
I'm freezing!!"
—The wind won't blow your way.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Heading straight into the center of the 
wind... That would be a favorable breeze, 
I presume."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: A hermit sage? Wait, am I hallucinating?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yamanin Zephyr... She's from the 
generation right after Daitaku Helios, and 
she has quite a unique presence."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...This way.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Brrrr-brrrr-brrrr...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—Please cross this bridge and proceed to 
the other side.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh? Did the snow... stop?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The forest is a place that bewilders 
mortals... Never forget that, not even in 
your dreams.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Are they seriously a mountain hermit?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Though nature had instead taught me its 
perils, I found myself soothed by the 
mystical aura surrounding Yamanin Zephyr."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I definitely gotta go pay my respects to 
the God of Fate! I'm always using their 
name without asking, after all.
choice_data_list: (So you were aware of it after all...)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh!? If it isn't Ikuno~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Helios-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus... She's in the same 
generation as Daitaku Helios, and goes by 
the alias "Iron Maiden."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy ayy, Happy New Year~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year~

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't that hilarious? Ikuno really 
gets into it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"We're heading to the shrine right now. 
Wanna come along?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes, I will accompany you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Right. First, wash your hands... Rinse 
your mouth too. Here's a handkerchief for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed like an unlikely pairing at 
first, but... I enjoyed watching the 
good-natured banter between the two 
surprisingly compatible girls.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh! Party animal~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, didn't someone I know 
say they were gonna make a move soon? 
Guess I'll go mess with 'em!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Wait, no way! Sha-tan is here~~!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Didn't I tell you I'd beat you senseless 
if you called me that again?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur... An Umamusume with a unique 
aura who always carries a laptop around 
with her.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hah?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's fiiiine! Sha-tan and I are besties, 
so I just know!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That just now meant 'That's right!☆' 
Right~!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm going home.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well, just hold on till you see the next 
one♪ My bestie's about to drop some 
absolute fire plays!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...You know that DJ too?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, besties~☆ Like hitting the public 
bath together after pulling an 
all-nighter!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
He mainly uses analog, right? Makes some 
pretty interesting sounds.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, totally, apparently it's all recorded 
at home for real! Using gear they got from 
a senior—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while, the two were having a blast 
chatting about their shared interest.
